sinopsis.es: Entre la niebla y las paredes agrietadas, un maestro transcurre su último día en una escuela rural que pronto cerrará sus puertas por falta de alumnos. En silenciosa soledad, se despide de un lugar que ha sido su oficio y su refugio durante años.
sinopsis.en: Shrouded in fog and crumbling stone, a teacher moves through his final day at a rural school, soon to be shut down for lack of students. In quiet solitude, he parts ways with a place that has been his craft and his shelter for years.
